title: 第九章 暗遣心腹寻旧人，东宫密筹害人计
content_zh:
指尖碾碎的花瓣化作细碎红痕落在掌心，沈清鸢缓缓收回目光，抬脚迈进汀兰院的月洞门。院内廊下悬着的纱灯已经点亮，暖黄光晕漫过阶前丛生的兰草，春桃紧随在侧，压低话音细说方才打探来的细节。

    “小姐，那送信的小厮走的是府后不起眼的小侧门，绕了两条偏僻街巷才进东宫，足足半个时辰才折返凝香院，想来太子那边已经给了回信。”

    沈清鸢走到石桌旁落座，桌上温着一壶菊花茶，热气袅袅。她端起瓷杯抿了一口，微凉的茶水压下心底翻涌的思绪。前世平宁侯府海棠宴就是她命运急转的分水岭，萧景煜联合柳氏母女，借偏僻水榭下药，毁她名节，之后婚约转手落在沈轻柔身上，柳氏借着太子撑腰，一步步蚕食生母留下的嫁妆，最后更是跟着太子构陷沈家满门。

    “柳氏眼下无路可走，只能依托太子在宴席动手。”沈清鸢放下茶盏，眸光沉静如水，“既然她们铁了心布下圈套，我便顺势入瓮。春桃，取二两纹银，连夜出城去往城郊农庄，去找从前伺候我生母的张嬷嬷。”

    张嬷嬷是为数不多亲眼见过柳氏暗中在夫人汤药动手脚的旧人，当年被柳氏罗织偷盗罪名发配乡野，在农庄受尽磋磨。前世沈清鸢身陷牢狱才知晓此人存在，今生她要早早把这人证攥在手里，留作日后扳倒柳氏的关键凭据。

    春桃不敢耽搁，收好银两趁着夜色悄悄出府。

    另一边凝香院内，烛火摇曳，柳氏捏着东宫传回的密信反复品读，眉眼间满是踏实。萧景煜已然敲定计谋，海棠宴当日遣心腹扮成侯府杂役，在后园临水凉亭设伏，寻机下药玷污沈清鸢，只要流言传开，沈清鸢再无资格做太子未婚妻，沈轻柔便能顺理成章顶替上位。

    沈轻柔靠在桌边把玩新得的珠钗，眉眼藏不住贪婪：“娘亲，只要事成，往后我便是堂堂太子侧妃，这相府嫡出的所有东西，早晚全归咱们。”

    柳氏皱眉叮嘱她收敛神色，摄政王如今处处偏向沈清鸢，行事万万不可露出破绽，一切静待宴席当天由东宫人手出手。

    同一时辰，东宫书房烛火通明。萧景煜将信纸扔进烛火，看着纸张燃成灰烬，面色冷沉。从前对自己俯首帖耳的沈清鸢接连坏了柳氏的谋划，已然失去利用价值，毁掉她的名声，迎娶听话温顺的沈轻柔，是稳固沈家助力最稳妥的法子。

    他朝外沉声吩咐侍卫，备好迷药，挑选四名亲信提前潜伏平宁侯府。

    摄政王府内，暗卫把东宫动向尽数禀报萧聿辞。男人指尖轻叩案面，眼底寒意漫起，前世海棠宴酿成的悲剧，他绝不会再让它重演，当即下令暗卫潜伏侯府周遭，紧盯东宫爪牙，坐等对方动手时当场擒获。

    夜色渐深，城郊乡间小路沾着入夜的露水，春桃揣好银两，借着月色一路打听，终于寻到张嬷嬷栖身的破茅屋。

    低矮的屋子四处漏风，炕上铺着薄薄一层干草，年过半百的张嬷嬷正就着微光搓着麻绳度日，看见一身丫鬟装束的春桃登门，起初满心戒备，只当是柳氏又派人来刁难。

    待春桃讲明来意，递上银子，转述沈清鸢想要替亡故主母翻查旧案的心思，张嬷嬷攥着沉甸甸的银锭，枯瘦的手不停发抖，积攒多年的委屈一下子涌了上来，浑浊的眼眶瞬间淌下泪水。

    当年她亲眼目睹柳氏暗中在主母安胎药里掺入伤身药材，转头就被安上偷窃首饰的罪名，无端赶出相府，在贫瘠农庄苦熬这些年，日日盼着能有机会替已故主子讨一个公道。如今嫡小姐有心查案，还许诺事成之后为她置办小院、安稳养老，张嬷嬷没有半点迟疑，当即点头应下，把当年藏起来的半张药渣凭据细心收好，只等候沈清鸢传唤。

    办妥事情，春桃不敢在外久留，趁着天色未亮匆匆折返相府。

    回到汀兰院时，沈清鸢还坐在窗边翻看生母遗留的嫁妆册子。听见脚步声，她抬眼看向风尘仆仆的春桃。

    “小姐，一切顺利，张嬷嬷已经应允作证，物证也妥善保管了。”

    沈清鸢淡淡颔首，指尖轻轻抚过泛黄的纸页。生母一辈子勤恳积攒下丰厚嫁妆，大半都被柳氏借着打理家事悄悄挪走，前世她到死都没能讨要回来，今生不光要护住自身清白，还要全数拿回属于生母的东西。

    转眼第二日，相府表面一派安稳，柳氏依旧日日带着沈轻柔在老夫人跟前尽孝，言行举止温顺恭谨，半点看不出暗中筹谋害人的心思。只是私下里，柳氏时不时遣小厮打探东宫动静，确认人手已经安排妥当，心底越发笃定海棠宴的算计万无一失。

    远在摄政王府，萧聿辞听完暗卫二次回禀，知晓东宫人马已经悄悄动身去往平宁侯府周边落脚。他推开窗，目光遥遥望向丞相府的方向，晚风掠过鬓边，心底暗自盘算。

    他默默守了沈清鸢一世凄凉下场，今生步步留心，只等着三日后海棠宴，将萧景煜与柳氏的龌龊算计当众戳穿，让这群作恶之人自食恶果。

    转眼便是海棠宴前一日，京城里各处世家车马往来频繁，不少贵女早早备好衣衫首饰，只待次日赴宴赏玩海棠。沈清鸢吩咐春桃备好出门穿戴，静等着第二日萧聿辞如约前来接应。
content_en:
The petals crushed by the fingertips turned into fine red marks and fell on the palm of the hand. Shen Qingyuan slowly withdrew his gaze and stepped into the Moon Cave Gate of Tinglan Courtyard.The gauze lantern hanging in the corridor in the courtyard has been lit, and the warm yellow light spreads through the orchid grass in front of the steps. Chuntao followed closely beside her, speaking in a low voice and detailing the details she had just found out.

"Miss, the boy who delivered the letter went through the inconspicuous side door behind the mansion and walked around two remote streets before entering the East Palace. It took half an hour to return to Ningxiang Courtyard. I think the prince has already given a reply to the letter."

Shen Qingyuan walked to the stone table and sat down. On the table was a pot of chrysanthemum tea, which was steaming with heat.She picked up the porcelain cup and took a sip. The slightly cold tea suppressed the turbulent thoughts in her heart.The Begonia Banquet at Marquis Pingning's Mansion in her previous life was a watershed moment for her fate. Xiao Jingyu teamed up with the Liu family and their daughter to drug her at a remote waterside pavilion to ruin her reputation. Afterwards, the engagement contract changed hands and fell to Shen Qingrou. With the support of the prince, the Liu family gradually eroded the dowry left by her biological mother, and finally followed the prince to frame the entire Shen family.

"Liu has no choice now, so she can only rely on the prince to take action at the banquet." Shen Qingyuan put down the tea cup, her eyes as calm as water, "Since they are determined to lay a trap, I will fall into the trap. Chuntao, take two taels of silver and go out of the city overnight to the farm on the outskirts of the city to find Aunt Zhang who used to serve my biological mother."

Nanny Zhang was one of the few old people who had witnessed Mr. Liu secretly tampering with his wife's medicine. Back then, she was accused of stealing by Ms. Liu and was sent to the countryside and suffered a lot on the farm.In her previous life, Shen Qingyuan didn't know about the existence of this person until she was in prison. In this life, she will have this person's evidence in her hands as a key evidence to overthrow the Liu family in the future.

Chuntao didn't dare to delay, so she collected her silver and quietly left the house at night.

On the other side of the Ningxiang Courtyard, the candlelight flickered. Mrs. Liu held the secret letter sent back from the East Palace and read it over and over again, her eyes full of peace of mind.Xiao Jingyu had already finalized his plan. On the day of the Begonia Banquet, he sent his confidants to pretend to be servants of the Hou Mansion and set up an ambush at the waterside pavilion in the back garden, looking for an opportunity to poison Shen Qingyuan. As long as rumors spread, Shen Qingyuan would no longer be qualified to be the prince's fiancée, and Shen Qingrou would be able to take his place.

Shen Qingrou leaned on the table and played with her newly acquired hairpin, her expressions unable to hide her greed: "Mother, as long as things are done, I will be the crown prince's concubine from now on. Everything that is the direct descendant of the prime minister's house will belong to us sooner or later."

Ms. Liu frowned and told her to calm down. The regent was now biased towards Shen Qingyuan in everything, and he must not expose any flaws in his actions. Everything would be handled by the people from the East Palace on the day of the banquet.

At the same time, candles were brightly lit in the study room of the East Palace.Xiao Jingyu threw the letter into the candlelight and watched it burn to ashes with a cold expression.Shen Qingyuan, who used to be submissive to him, ruined Liu's plans one after another and has lost her use value and ruined her reputation. Marrying the obedient and docile Shen Qingrou is the safest way to stabilize the Shen family's support.

He ordered the guards in a deep voice to prepare the poison and select four close associates to lurk in Pingninghou Mansion in advance.

In the Regent's Palace, the secret guards reported all the movements in the East Palace to Xiao Yuci.The man tapped his fingertips on the table, and a chill filled his eyes. He would never let the tragedy caused by the Begonia Banquet in his previous life happen again. He immediately ordered the secret guards to lurk around the Marquis Mansion, keeping an eye on the minions of the East Palace, waiting to be captured on the spot when the other party made a move.

The night was getting darker, and the country roads on the outskirts of the city were stained with night dew. Chuntao took some money and asked around under the moonlight, and finally found the shabby thatched hut where Nanny Zhang lived.

The low house was leaky, and the kang was covered with a thin layer of hay. Aunt Zhang, who was over fifty years old, was rubbing hemp ropes in the dim light to spend her days. She saw Chuntao dressed as a maid coming to the door. At first, she was wary and thought it was the Liu family who had sent someone to cause trouble again.

After Chuntao explained her purpose of coming, handed over the money, and relayed Shen Qingyuan's desire to look into the old cases for her late mistress, Granny Zhang clutched the heavy silver ingot, her skinny hands kept shaking, and the grievances she had accumulated for many years suddenly came to her, and tears instantly fell from her cloudy eyes.

Back then, she witnessed Mrs. Liu secretly mixing her mistress's anti-fetal medicine with health-harming medicinal materials. Then she was accused of stealing jewelry and was kicked out of the prime minister's palace for no reason. She suffered in the barren farm for these years, hoping every day to have the opportunity to seek justice for her late master.Now that the concubine is interested in investigating the case, she also promised to buy a small home for her and provide her with a stable retirement after the matter is completed. Grandma Zhang did not hesitate at all, she immediately nodded in agreement, carefully put away the half-sheet of medicine residue certificates that she had hidden, and only waited for Shen Qingyuan to summon her.

After finishing the matter, Chuntao did not dare to stay outside for a long time, so she hurriedly returned to the Prime Minister's Mansion before dawn.

When she returned to Tinglan Courtyard, Shen Qingyuan was still sitting by the window looking through the dowry booklet left by her biological mother.Hearing the footsteps, she raised her eyes to look at the dusty Chuntao.

"Miss, everything goes well. Aunt Zhang has agreed to testify and the physical evidence has been properly kept."

Shen Qingyuan nodded lightly and gently stroked the yellowed paper with her fingertips.The biological mother worked hard throughout her life to accumulate a generous dowry, but most of it was quietly taken away by Ms. Liu while taking care of the house. In her previous life, she was unable to get it back until her death. In this life, she not only has to protect her innocence, but also gets back everything that belongs to her biological mother.

In the blink of an eye, the next day, the Prime Minister's Mansion seemed stable on the surface. Mrs. Liu still took Shen Qingrou to fulfill her filial piety in front of the old lady every day. Her words and deeds were gentle and respectful, and there was no trace of her secretly plotting to harm others.But in private, Mrs. Liu sent her servants from time to time to inquire about the activities in the East Palace to confirm that the manpower had been arranged properly, and she became more and more sure that Haitang Yan's plan was foolproof.

Far away in the Prince Regent's Mansion, Xiao Yuci heard the second report from the secret guard and learned that the men from the East Palace had quietly set off to settle near Pingninghou Mansion.He opened the window and looked far away in the direction of the Prime Minister's Mansion. The evening breeze blew past his temples, and he made secret calculations in his heart.

He silently guarded Shen Qingyuan's miserable end, and was careful every step of his life. He was only waiting for the Haitang Banquet three days later to expose Xiao Jingyu and the Liu family's dirty plan in public, and let these evildoers reap the consequences.

In a blink of an eye, it was the day before the Begonia Banquet, and there were frequent carriages and horses from various aristocratic families in the capital. Many noble ladies had prepared their clothes and jewelry early, just to go to the banquet the next day to enjoy the Begonias.Shen Qingyuan told Chuntao to get ready to go out and wait for Xiao Yuci to come to meet him as promised the next day.
